claims.text: Title LXVIII, sec. 6802(a), amends 50 U.S.C. 3373 in full to establish the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office; sec. 6802(b) makes the conforming clerical amendment to the FY2022 NDAA table of contents, striking the old sec. 1683 item and inserting 'Sec. 1683. Establishment of All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office.'

Sec. 6803, note '50 USC 3373 note', is titled 'COMPTROLLER GENERAL OF THE UNITED STATES AUDITS AND BRIEFINGS ON UNIDENTIFIED ANOMALOUS PHENOMENA HISTORICAL RECORD REPORT'; its briefing cadence was later sunset by sec. 6802 of PL 118-159.

connections.edgeLabel: Division F of P.L. 117-263 - the intelligence-side half of the same enactment
connections.label: Enacted Statute
connections.note: Sec. 6802 rewrote 50 U.S.C. 3373 to create AARO and inserted the 'unidentified anomalous phenomena' and 'transmedium' definitions; sec. 6803 attached a Comptroller General audit and briefing requirement to the Historical Record Report. Wiring it here fixes a degree-1 orphan and records that the statutory definitions the whole board uses were enacted in an intelligence authorization, not a defence one.
